newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals ease, state firms seen cutting rates.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals ease, state firms seen cutting rates.

text.p: Indian metals fell on Thursday partly due to fears that state-owned agencies may cut selling prices for the second half of this month, dealers said.
"Industrial demand remained slow while improved arrivals as well as falling global prices triggered unloading by importers," one dealer said. Ready copper fell by 50 rupees to 12,300.
It fell by 50 rupees on Wednesday. Nickel fell by 200 rupees to 36,800 rupees while tin fell by 200 rupees to 34,500 rupees per quintal. Zinc slid by 25 rupees at 6,450 rupees.
Aluminium however remained quiet at 7,300 rupees and lead at 4,450 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
